independent_exact.method: direct enumeration of every candidate A string; explicit set of all length-M subsequences; count instances with unique missing X

proof_gate.lemma: Unique missing X iff A decomposes as B1 x1 B2 x2 ... x_{M-1} B_M; Bt excludes x_t and covers every other symbol; when x_t!=x_{t+1}, the distinguished x_{t+1} has an occurrence after the first complete cover of Bt.
proof_gate.counting: F_l is the number of surjective length-l words over K-1 symbols; transition block count G_l=sum_{r<l}F_r*(K-2)^(l-1-r), hence G_l=F_{l-1}+(K-2)G_{l-1}; convolution over blocks is exact.
proof_gate.inductive_reason: Greedy matching of X is forced to the separators. At the first position where any Y differs from X, the relevant block and transition condition supply a complete alphabet before the recursively universal suffix; conversely violation of a block condition creates an additional missing length-M word.

constraint.complexity: O(N(K-1)+M*S^2), S=N-(MK-1+transitions), with immediate zero if S<0

independent_exact.method: enumerate all binary N x N matrices for N=2..4; group by exact row/column margins and derive varying coordinates in each class

proof_gate.orientation: Orient each K_{N,N} cell edge by its 0/1 value. A cell is non-fixed iff its directed edge lies on a directed cycle iff its endpoints are in the same SCC; balanced differences between equal-margin orientations decompose into alternating cycles.
proof_gate.components: Every nontrivial SCC has a,b>=2 row/column vertices and contributes exactly a*b non-fixed cells. Conversely any collection of disjoint (a,b), a,b>=2, is realizable by strongly orienting each K_{a,b}, ordering SCCs, and orienting cross edges forward; leftover vertices are singletons.
proof_gate.dp: Bitset DP over used row budget, column budget, and sum a*b is necessary and sufficient.

independent_exact.method: enumerate every permutation for N=1..7, group by directly computed previous-smaller descriptor A, compare executable candidate multiplicities

proof_gate.cartesian: A_i is exactly the previous-smaller stack trace. The frozen stack reconstruction uniquely determines the min-Cartesian tree.
proof_gate.count: Permutations with that descriptor are exactly min-heap labelings of the reconstructed rooted tree; tree hook-length formula gives N!/product subtree_size.

constraint.complexity: O(N log MOD) due modular inverses, O(N) storage
